# ZCU208 MTS overlay

## Features

* Multi-Tile Synchronization (MTS)
  * 8 ADC, 8 DAC fully enabled
* Deterministic loop-back latency
* Clocks
  * 4Gsps synchronous sampling rate
  * 500MHz fabric clock (8 samples per cycle)
  * Externally referenced to 500MHz PL_CLK clock by CLK104 J11
  * Generated by CLK104 LMX
  * Aligned by 5MHz PL_SYSREF clock by CLK104 LMK
* Digital mixer
  * NCO mixer (IQ) digital up/down conversion
  * NCO phase aligned
* 64k samples buffer for:
  * Arbitrary waveform generator, broadcasted to all DACs
  * I and Q waveforms for each ADC
* 8GB DDR4 Programmable Logic (PL) memory for deep capturing samples
* MRF Timing Event Receiver (EVR)
  * Through zSFP 2
  * Self-recovery from timing link interruptions
  * Deterministic latency
  * Generate event flags by subscribing an event code
  * Arbitrary GTY reference frequency generation via Silicon Lab SI570
* Trigger
  * Multiplex trigger source between software, internal and EVR
  * Synchronous trigger to all DACs / ADCs

## Status

- [x] ADC / DAC waveforms
- [x] MTS tested
- [x] MRF Timing Event Receiver (EVR) tested
